# SasaVenos Says You Do Not Need Bad Form To Progress

Asked whether you need bad form to progress, SasaVenos answers that you don't need bad form. [src: vid-OYFU5AyLl9w]

## Details

- Asked whether you need bad form to progress, he answers that you don't need bad form. [src: vid-OYFU5AyLl9w]
- He says there is no reason why you would need it. [src: vid-OYFU5AyLl9w]
- He says he is not completely against it: if you enjoy training with bad form, you can still make progress. [src: vid-OYFU5AyLl9w]

## Evidence

- vid-OYFU5AyLl9w (SasaVenos): "So Sasha, do you actually need bad form to progress? Yes or no."
- vid-OYFU5AyLl9w (SasaVenos): "You know the answer. You don't need bad form."
- vid-OYFU5AyLl9w (SasaVenos): "you don't need that form and there's no reason why you would need them."
- vid-OYFU5AyLl9w (SasaVenos): "I'm not completely against that."
- vid-OYFU5AyLl9w (SasaVenos): "if you enjoy training with bad form, you don't want to, you know, be pedantic with everything, you know, do it, you know, do whatever you want. You can still make progress."
